scope: Acknowledge Intel primary interrupt-window control without altering other controls, guest frontiers, debugger completion or caller-owned IRQs.

assumption_register.assumption: A currently admitted Intel primary control word may retain interrupt-window bit2 across a checkpoint and generate exit7 when IF=1 without STI/MOV-SS blocking.
assumption_register.basis: Retained Intel SDM Vol.3C26.6.2/Table26-6, AppendixC; actual checkpoint policy admits dynamic primary bit2.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Acknowledge the window control before another native entry, preserving every other bit.
assumption_register.stress_test: Restored finite/FOREVER entry, repeated independent windows, pending input and monitor-trap control.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A successful acknowledgement leaves bit2 set, changes another primary bit, retires a guest instruction or produces a debug completion.
assumption_register.status: retained; complete actual-owner SDK models qualify retained and already-acknowledged controls; physical Intel behavior remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: An SDK error or unequal full control readback after acknowledgement makes continued native entry unsafe.
assumption_register.basis: A setter can fail before or after changing the VMCS; existing native entry_result fences on propagated errors.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Do not retry acknowledgement or enter again after read/write/readback failure.
assumption_register.stress_test: Read-before, write-before, write-after, read-after, ignored setter, mutation of the monitor-trap bit.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A failed acknowledgement permits a second native entry or is reported as successful.
assumption_register.status: confirmed for complete current owner/SDK models: all six read/write/readback partitions fence before another entry; physical SDK failure behavior remains unqualified

assumption_register.assumption: Normal VM exit clears VM-entry interruption-information valid, whereas the failed-entry path preserves it.
assumption_register.dependent_result: SDK fixture fidelity only; no new backend valid-bit clearing operation.
assumption_register.stress_test: Actual public interrupt injection, normal timer exit and failed entry carrying the prior event.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The model clears valid after a failed entry, retains valid after a normal exit, or a backend workaround replaces architectural hardware behavior.
assumption_register.status: confirmed primary-derived model contract with explicit normal exit and allocated failed-entry reason33; no physical Intel event-delivery claim
